title: The Timeout Michigan Didn't Have
setup: The 1993 national championship game in New Orleans. With 11 seconds left, Michigan trails North Carolina 72-71. Chris Webber signals for a timeout. Michigan has none left. Its last one was called with 46 seconds to go, and the coaches had reminded the team it had none remaining.
question: What do the officials call?
options: A technical foul on Michigan, and Carolina shoots two free throws.
The play is ruled a jump ball.
ruling: The officials called a technical foul on Webber. Donald Williams made both technical free throws, and Carolina added two more after Michigan fouled on the next possession. North Carolina won 77-71.
rulebookNote: Michigan's last timeout had already been used, so the request drew a technical foul.
